data.one_liner: Deprecated wrapper that re‑exports opentelemetry_wk for backward compatibility.
data.what_it_does: The package does nothing on its own; it simply forwards all symbols to the opentelemetry_wk package. It exists so existing imports continue to work while migration to opentelemetry_wk is performed.
use_when: You have existing code that imports package:opentelemetry and want a quick migration path
You need a temporary shim while updating dependencies
avoid_when: You are starting a new project – depend on opentelemetry_wk directly
You need any functionality beyond what opentelemetry_wk provides
strengths: Simplifies migration from the old package name
weaknesses: Deprecated and will receive no new features
Adds an extra dependency layer that may cause confusion
